new.n: St. Joseph County fair grounds, Centreville (by 1858)
new.pl: 'Agricultural Exhibition Ground' with Exhibition House and oval track, S of Charlotte St, E of Franklin St, N of King St (1858 county map inset); 1914/1916 USGS draws the track about 115 m away
new.v: Fairground coin and token drops from 19th-century county fairs
new.st: Centreville held the St. Joseph County fair from the 1850s (it is on Neb's 1850s-60s and 1869 fair lists). The 1858 county map draws an 'Agricultural Exhibition Ground' with an exhibition house and an oval track at the SE corner of the original plat, and the 1914 USGS map still draws a track there, so the grounds stayed put. The St. Joseph County Grange Fair still runs at Centreville, so this is probably today's fairground.
new.t: Probably still active fair land: ask the fair association; never during fair week. Gathering grounds: under the oldest trees, the flat where the crowd stood, the track edges and where wagons parked.
src: Geil & Jones, Map of St. Joseph County, Michigan (1858), Centreville inset (Library of Congress 2012593162)

new.n: Clinton County fair grounds, St. Johns (bought 1866)
new.pl: 'Fair Ground 20' acres with oval track, E edge of NE¼ sec 20 T7N R2W, a mile south of the village (1873 atlas); 1927 USGS draws the track on the same spot
new.v: Fairground coin and token drops from 19th-century county fairs
new.st: In 1866 the Clinton County Agricultural Society bought 30 acres 'one mile south of the village' of St. Johns; a judges' stand was built in 1879. The 1873 county atlas marks 'Fair Ground 20' acres with an oval track, and the 1927 USGS map draws the track on the same spot.
new.t: Check today's use before going: private land needs the owner's permission. Gathering grounds: under the oldest trees, the flat where the crowd stood, the track edges and where wagons parked.
src: Atlas of Clinton County, Michigan (1873), Bingham Twp (Library of Congress 2010587156)

new.n: Central Fair grounds (four counties), east of Hubbardston (1870s)
new.pl: 'Central Fair Association 20' acres, NW¼ sec 18 T8N R4W, just east of the village (1873 atlas; 1880 county history)
new.v: Fairground coin and token drops from 19th-century county fairs
new.st: The Central Fair of Ionia, Montcalm, Gratiot and Clinton counties held its fairs on 20-30 acres in section 18 of Lebanon Township, just east of Hubbardston. The 1873 Clinton atlas marks the 'Central Fair Association' grounds.
new.t: No pre-1965 USGS map covers it, so the track is not confirmed on the ground. Private land: ask permission. Gathering grounds: under the oldest trees, the flat where the crowd stood, the track edges and where wagons parked.
